newsitem.title: USA: FINA Oil, Seitel well offsets Fandango field.
newsitem.headline: FINA Oil, Seitel well offsets Fandango field.

text.p: Seitel Inc said Thrusday it has a stake in a FINA Inc discovery well offsetting Fandango Field in Zapata County, Texas.
The Rancho Blanco-State 1 well is scheduled to commence commercial production on August 1.

Operated by FINA's FINA Oil and Chemical Co unit, the well recorded test-flow rates of 9.2 million cubic feet of gas per day, on a 15/64-inch choke with flow tubing pressure of 9,210 pounds per square inch. During an extensive testing period, production was from selective perforations between 16,097 and 17,642 feet from four productive zones from Lower Wilcox-age sands. Total depth drilled was to 18,392 feet.
Seitel said a second prospect in this approximate 7,000-acre project adjacent to Fandango Field commenced drilling earlier this month, with total depth targeted near 20,000 feet.
In the Fandango-offset project, FINA and Zachry Exploration Inc own 33.33 pct each, while Seitel and Cox & Perkins Inc hold 16.67 each.
